game.name: FTL: Faster Than Light
game.desc: A roguelike spaceship simulation. Command a Federation ship and its crew on a run across a galaxy at war: route power between systems, fight in real time with the option to pause at any moment, board and get boarded, and reach the Federation fleet before the Rebels catch you. Every run is a new galaxy. Gamepad and touch support is provided by FTLHELM, a custom control layer. See the in-game help for controls.
